Commentary.Commentary: That is it from Game 13 of this tournament. With Australia and India qualifying for the final four, the remaining matches of Group B become a dead rubber. But Group A is still alive with four teams out of five still in with a chance. Our next coverage though, will be Australia vs India, on Saturday, November 17, 2018 at 11 am local (1500 GMT) at this very same venue. That will be played mainly for bragging the rights to top the group. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, is happy on the qualification for the semis but feels that there are a lot of areas to improve. On the plan to give bowling to so many bowlers, Kaur says that the idea was about thinking ahead, about a game deeper in the tournament, should one of your main bowlers fail. On the areas of improvement, Harmanpreet is not too happy at all. Says that the batters failed to play their normal game while the main bowlers were not consistent.

Ireland skipper, Laura Delany, says that she is very happy with the bowling in the first place. Then is happier that the batting did not collapse entirely but worked on the partnerships. Also feels that the fielding was a lot sharper in this game. Admits that they are still working hard on finding the right balance in the batting order. Says that the Irish are totally taken aback after being knocked out of the tournament. Stresses that they get a lot of support throughout the world and is full of thanks for their supporters.

MITHALI RAJ HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. First she is asked about her knee - she responds by saying that it will get better and she should be able to play the next game. On the wicket, she says that today it was very soft and batting was challenging. Adds that the opening partnership with Mandhana was the key and hopes that they get a better wicket in the next match. Is not too perturbed with Smriti's poor form and feels that she is getting better and better with every game. On the team overall, Mithali says that this one has definitely improved from the last World Cup, with plenty of young girls in the side and wanting to win. Wants this side to play the final. On the batting preparation, Raj says that you do have 2-3 shots for one delivery and it all depends on execution. Does not want to go too hard over clearing the fence and relies more on timing.

A decent outing for India with the ball. The only debate would be whether they needed to bowl that wide with the new ball. They struggled to pick up wickets but were fairly consistent in keeping the boundaries minimal. Towards the end, Radha Yadav picked up 3 wickets while Poonam Yadav and Harmanpreet Kaur had joint figures of 8-0-24-2, which stifled the opposition with Deepti picking up 2 as well. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Ireland were simply not good enough with the bat. They flopped against Australia and Pakistan and were no match today either. They started slowly, aiming to bat big as the game went on but the acceleration never came. Only Shillington and Joyce managed to reach double figures, scoring around 60 percent of the team's total.

After being asked to bat under slightly overcast skies and damp conditions, the Indians did well to get off to a good start, albeit Ireland had a lot of say in that, not being consistent enough and missing too many chances. At one stage, the Indians were on course to get to around 170-180 but they messed it up in the last few overs, managing only 145. But even that proved to be enough.

As expected, comprehensive win for India. They were always the superior team heading into this contest and they have strut their stuff. With this victory, they join Australia as the second team in the final four, knocking New Zealand, Pakistan and Ireland out.
A reverse sweep attempted to end the match, only to miss. INDIA WIN BY 52 RUNS AND QUALIFY FOR THE SEMIS!

Short and outside off, finally Raack connects, punching it towards cover. She sets off for a single but Waldron is slow to get off the blocks. There is an easy run out on offer but the fielder fumbles.
Bowled extremely slow outside off, punch missed this time.
Outside off, staying low, Raack looks to cut but misses. Good take behind.
Full and outside off, Mary looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to short third man. A quick single.
Outside off, Waldron looks to play the reverse slog but misses.
Celeste Raack is the new batter in at number 10. Poonam Yadav to finish this off.

OUT! STUMPED! HAT-TRICK FOR INDIA! A flurry of wickets here. Full and outside off, Maritz comes down the track and looks to swing but is completely beaten. Easy stumping. Third one for her and third wicket for Radha! 4-0-25-3 are her bowling figures.
Lara Maritz walks in at number 9.

OUT! Run out. Similar to the Hemalatha dismissal earlier in the day. On middle, Waldron flicks it through square leg and set off for a single. Richardson meanwhile, took the first run fast and turned blind for the second. Poor Waldron had barely touched her bat at the non-striker's end when Richardson was halfway down. Easy run out at the keeper's end.
Mary Waldron comes out at number 8, with 8 balls left.

OUT! No, the keeper has not hit the stumps with her gloves. Instead, the ball has hit them! The batter is bowled! Full and outside off, Garth had come down the track and looked to hit but missed. The keeper whipped off the bails and the batter was adjudged out but the third umpire then intervened. At first look, it seemed like the keeper had hit the stumps with her gloves. But then, from the sideways angle, it became pretty clear that the ball had hit the timber first.
Gone, stumped! But what is the issue? Garth is walking off but has been asked to wait... Is it a no ball? Nope. Has the keeper hit the stumps with her gloves?
Once again the paddle is attempted, from well outside off. She misses and the ball goes off the bat handle towards short third man. A quick single taken.
Full and outside off, slogged towards widish long on for a couple.
Comes down the track and drives it through cover for a single.
Radha Yadav to bowl the 19th over. 3-0-20-1 so far.
Short ball, pulled away for one.
Pushes this through mid off for a run.
Full and miles outside off, now Richardson gets across and attempts to paddle - only to miss. Is hit on the pads and the keeper appeals for LBW but the umpire moves away.
Eimear Richardson is the new batter in at number 7, replacing Joyce.

OUT! Straight to hand! The skipper gets a wicket now. None of the paddle sweeps have fetched Ireland any success. Neither does this one. Gets a long way across and tries to lap it fine but only succeeds in hitting it straight to Poonam Yadav at short fine leg. Just a little bit of running needed to be done by the fielder. Kaur is smiling. She has been excellent with the ball today.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a run.
Full and outside off, swept away for a single.
Full and outside off, Garth goes back to cut but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Kim Garth walks in at number 6, replacing Kavanagh.

OUT! LBW! The decision is overturned! Full and outside off, Kavanagh plays that from her crease and tries to turn it to the leg side but misses because of the ball turning in instead. Is hit on the p;ads and Deepti appeals but the umpire shakes his head. She immediately signals towards her skipper to refer it upstairs and Kaur obliges. Hawk Eye shows that to be dead plumb.
HUGE SHOUT FOR LBW! The umpire shakes his head. Harmanpreet signals for a review. That looks close...
This time she connects, swinging it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track but is beaten comprehensively by the turn, coming in from a short length, is beaten and is hot on the pads as she looks to flick.
FOUR! Another good strike. Two boundaries in a row. Quicker through the air this time, a bit short, Joyce reaches out and slog sweeps it over square leg!
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Joyce comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Deepti Sharma is back on. 2-0-6-1 so far.
Comes down the track and swings it over mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, once again, Joyce looks to sweep but misses.

It is just a single but the captain is not happy. 'SO RAHI HAI KYA WAHAAN PAR? quips Harmanpreet. Full and outside off, Shauna gets down and across and sweeps it straight to short fine leg. But the fielder is a tad slow to get to the ball and allows the easy single.
Third play and a miss in a row. Landed outside off, this time Kavanagh looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Same ball, same shot, same result.
Landed outside off, Kavanagh looks to cut but misses.
Harmanpreet Kaur is back. 2-0-4-0 so far.
Full and outside off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shauna Kavanagh walks in at number 5, replacing her skipper.

OUT! STUMPED! The missed run out barely hurts India. Full and outside off, tossed up very slowly, Delany comes down the track and swings hard but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Bhatia collects and then whips off the bails leaving Delany absolutely no chance of coming back. Second stumping for her.
Comes down the track and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.

DIRECT HIT MIGHT HAVE BEEN A CLOSE CALL. Outside off, Delany pushed it towards point and set off for a quick single. Deepti Sharma came charging in to the ball, had a shy at the bowler's end but missed. Replays show that Laura was short.
Dropped short again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single. 79 more needed from 35 balls.
Radha Yadav returns. 2-0-15-0 so far.
Punches this through point for a run.
A touch short outside off, sliced towards point again.
Landed outside off, cut straight to point.
Gets a long way across and heaves it towards wide long on. Just a run.
Full and outside off, swept straight to mid-wicket.
WIDE. Full and outside off, slower ball gone awry, is well outside off. Left alone.
Short and outside off, placed through the covers for a single.
Poonam Yadav returns. 2-0-8-1 so far.
Full again, a touch wider outside off, driven straight to cover.

NEARLY DRAGS IT ON! Joyce is getting frustrated out there. Full and outside off, Isobel gets across and looks to sweep but misses. The ball spins in, takes the inside edge and just misses the stumps, enroute fine leg! Two runs taken.
Outside off, driven straight to cover.
Short and outside off, spins in, Delany looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to short third man. A quick run taken.
Fetches this from outside off and drags the sweep through square leg for a run.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
WIDE. Starts off with a loose one down the leg side, left alone.
Another bowling change. Jemimah Rodrigues given an opportunity.
Pre-meditated paddle scoop, gets well outside off, mistimes it towards short fine leg.
Works this through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, Delany looks to defend but the ball holds off the surface, comes late, hits the top half of the bat and lobs back to the bowler. Nearly carries.
On middle and leg, swept through square leg for a single.
Nicely bowled, given a bit of loop, outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, Delany comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Good one for Ireland. 10 coming from it. 50 IS UP. Full and around off, Joyce gets down and across and sweeps it pretty fine, finding the gap and the boundary. The stand is now worth 11 from 13 balls.
Outside off, turned towards long on for a run.
Gets well across her stumps and looks to paddle scoop, but mistimes it towards square leg. Just a single.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Landed outside off, much fuller, Isobel defends it from here crease.
FOUR! TAKE THAT! Short and outside off, Joyce goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary! 99 more needed from 59 balls.
Dayalan Hemalatha to bowl now.
Around off, solidly defended.
Goes back, opens the bat-face and steers it through third man for a single.
Outside off, pushed straight to short extra cover.
Full and outside off, slogged through mid-wicket for just a single.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Skipper Harmanpreet Kaur comes into the attack now.
Another googly, Delany does not pick it at all and looks to punch but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Skipper Laura Delany walks in at number 4, replacing Shillington.

OUT! Third time lucky for Taniya Bhatia! She has two stumping appeals so far, both against Shillington, both being not out. This time, she does not need to appeal only. Floated outside off, Clare comes down the track, looks to hit inside out but misses. Easy stumping for Bhatia and no chance for Shillington to get back either. She was so far down the track. The ploy of doing a Mithali Raj for Ireland does not quite materialize.
The wrong 'un, flicked through mid-wicket for another single.
Full and outside off, hit straight back over the bowler's head for a run.
A short ball, well outside off, Isobel gets a long way across and pulls - but straight to deep square leg. Just a single.
Oh dear... the googly, outside off, Joyce does not pick it at all and gets a thick inside edge onto her pads, initially going for the cut but then trying to defend.
Down the leg side, helped past short fine leg for a couple.
NOT OUT! The foot was in the air but got back in. Full and outside off, Shillington looked to slog but missed. Taniya Bhatia quickly collected and took the bails off and appealed but in vain.
ANOTHER STUMPING APPEAL! Like last time, Bhatia looks confident again. Is Shillington gone?
Around off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and much straighter, Shillington misses her flick and the ball goes off her pads to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
More spin, from outside off, almost onto leg stump, guided straight to short third man.
Landed outside off, spinning in, cut straight to point.
Short and outside off, spinning away, cut straight to cover.

The physio has come rushing out to the middle. Mithali is taking ages to get up and is hobbling in pain. There is a bit of a chat and the decision is to WALK OFF THE GROUND. Does not look too much in comfort.
Gets across and sweeps it towards square leg where Mithali gets down but is hit on the knee. She does not look too happy...
Bowled slowly through the air, outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
FOUR! SPANKED! Full and outside off, Shillington gets down and mows the slog sweep through mid-wicket! 1000 T20I RUNS FOR CLARE SHILLINGTON!
Full and outside off, pushed toward cover.

NOT OUT. The foot is in. Full and outside off, Shillington swings wildly to the leg side but misses. Extravagant turn on that and the keeper does well to collect. She is very confident after whipping the bails off and almost runs towards the square leg umpire in excitement. It is referred upstairs but replays confirm that Clare is in.
A stumping appeal straightaway! Has Poonam struck? Referred upstairs...
Poonam Yadav into the attack now.
Full and around off, Joyce looks to sweep but gets a top edge which eludes the players running back from short fine leg and square leg. Two runs taken. Just 3 runs and a wicket from her opening over.
On middle and leg, punched towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, swept straight to short fine leg.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
On middle and leg, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Isobel Joyce walks in at number 3, replacing Lewis.

OUT! BOWLED! That has gone straight through! Change of pace has done the job. Tossed up outside off, Lewis looks to gets across and play it straight but the ball spins in a mile, goes past the bat and knocks the off stump out of the ground. Excellent bowling. The watchful 27-run stand has been broken and Ireland, possibly looking for a move on, have been pegged back.
Deepti Sharma introduced into the attack.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Landed outside off, pretty wide, Clare thinks about going after it but then lets it go.
FOUR! SMOKED! A juicy full toss, on middle, Shillington just dispatches it over mid-wicket, one bounce and into the ropes. 119 more needed from 92 balls.
Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, slogged through square leg for a couple.
Full and outside off, Lewis steps down the crease and times her drive beautifully - but straight to the fielder at mid off.
The arm ball, Clare flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
FOUR! That is a full toss and it has been put away. Shillington get down and mows it over mid-wicket.
Full and around off, driven towards deepish mid off for a run.
WIDE. Full and outside off, Lewis looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. The keeper is not happy.
Landed outside off, turning away, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven wide of long off for a single.
Wide outside off, left alone. A MAIDEN FROM MANSI!
Full again, driven straight to cover again.
Half volley outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
This time the line is not too far outside off. Gaby looks to drive but mistimes it towards mid off.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Leis looks to drive but misses.
Short and outside off again, CS misses out on the cut.
Short and outside off, cut between short third man and backward point for a couple.
WIDE. Full and outside off, Clare lets it go. The ball spins past the wide guidelines.
Full and outside of again, this time Gaby connects with her drive, hitting it uppishly towards sweeper cover for a run.
Full and outside off, Lewis looks to drive but misses.
WIDE. Way outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
A length ball outside off, Shillington swings it over mid on for a couple.
Radha Yadav to share the new ball.
Full and wide outside off, Lewis slashes but misses.
Wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Short and down the leg side, pulled past short fine leg for a boundary!
Looks to flick but gets a leading edge, landing short of gully.
Punches this through point but a good fielding effort saves runs.
ALMOST A CATCH! Short and wide outside off, Shillington cuts it hard and just about evades gully! A single taken.
